title: Invertibility of the intrinsic evaluation-defined site Hom map
statement:
theorem finiteHomSiteHomInvertible
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K M : finiteHomEtale l E X n),
      finiteTorConstructibleEtale l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X K →
      coefFiniteHomEtaleConstructible l E X n M →
      IsIso (finiteHomSiteHom l E X n K M)

proof.text: Apply finite duality site comparison with the finite-Tor constructible first input and bounded constructible second input.

Transport along the existing intrinsic realization/restriction equivalence. Normalize both evaluations and the site tensorator on flat-term K-flat representatives; their transposes agree, identifying the transported map with finiteHomSiteHom.
The comparison transported across an equivalence is invertible, so its identified intrinsic map is invertible.
